   Sports Davis Allen Week 7 Preview vs. the Raiders
 Oct 25, 2026 Photo : Sean M. Haffey / Getty Images Sport / Getty Images 
 Los Angeles Rams receiver Davis Allen has a favorable matchup in Week 7 (Sunday at 4:25 p.m. ET), facing the Las Vegas Raiders. The Raiders are conceding the eighth-most passing yards in the NFL, 237.3 per game.
 Allen has collected 63 receiving yards on six catches this season, averaging 10.5 yards per game.
 Listen to the game on 93.1 Jack FM 
 Allen vs. the Raiders
 Allen vs the Raiders (since 2021): No games
 Two players have collected 100 or more receiving yards in a game against Las Vegas in the 2026 season.
 The Raiders have conceded a TD pass to nine opposing players this year.
 Four opposing players have hauled in at least two TD passes in matchups with Las Vegas on the season.
 The pass defense of the Raiders is conceding 237.3 yards per contest this year, which ranks 25th in the NFL.
 The Raiders' defense is 28th in the league by allowing 2.2 passing touchdowns per game to opposing offenses (13 total passing TDs).
 Catch NFL action all year long on Fubo. 
 Allen Receiving Insights
 Allen has hit the over on his receiving yards prop in one of two games (50.0%).
 Allen has 3.6% of his team's target share (nine targets on 252 passing attempts).
 He has been targeted nine times this season, averaging 7.0 yards per target.
 Allen, in six games this year, has zero TD receptions.
